title: studio: the page-create seed and the page preview build the default record page without the runtime's detail sections, so an object with no fieldGroups gets a bare `record:details` unlike the running app
body:
Filing gate **① a measured preview ≠ runtime divergence**, read in code on objectui `main` `6843f7599`. It surfaced from the objectui#12433 dev's report (PR #12441). ⛔ Not reproduced in a browser; a read-only reading.

- **Filed by:** objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post #5560) · `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`. ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.
- `reach:` a Studio author who creates or previews a record page for an object that declares no `fieldGroups`. The dev's rough census counts about 31 of 111 objectstack object files with no `highlightFields`; the `fieldGroups` count is not measured.

## What the code does

- **Runtime:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` `:3341` calls `buildDefaultPageSchema(objectDef, { sections: synthParts.sections, highlightFields: …, … })`. The running app's default record page always carries explicit detail sections: the object's field groups, else the full visible-field split.
- **Studio page-create seed:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/anchors.ts:208` calls `buildDefaultPageSchema(objectDef)` with no `sections`.
- **Studio slotted preview:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PagePreview.tsx:301` calls `buildDefaultPageSchema(recordSchema, { slots })` with no `sections`.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` derives `sections` only from declared `fieldGroups` when none are passed. So for an object without `fieldGroups`, the seed and the preview emit a bare `record:details`.
- **The effect:**
  - Since PR #12441 (objectui#12433), a bare `record:details` draws the object's `highlightFields`, the spec's declared fallback. On an object with no `highlightFields` it draws an empty body.
  - So the page Studio seeds, and the preview Studio shows, can differ from what the running app's default page draws for the same object.
  - A page created from that seed persists the bare node.

## Ask

- The seed and the preview pass the same detail sections the runtime passes (one shared derivation, not a second copy). A page Studio creates, and the preview it shows, then draw what the running app draws.
- **Pins:** seed, preview and runtime agree on the detail body for an object with no `fieldGroups`. CONTROL: an object with `fieldGroups` is unchanged.
- **Related:**
  - objectui#12433's open question A3 (what a bare node draws when the object declares no `highlightFields`). The seat answered it in its ACCEPT on PR #12441: no new spec fallback; this card closes the only route into that case.
  - `resolveDetailSections`' doc still says it "falls back to its flat layout".

Dedupe: semantic search over objectui issues, closed included, for "Studio page create seed / page preview buildDefaultPageSchema without sections differs from runtime record page": no match. The nearest are objectui#11933 (preview drops the page type) and objectui#10482 (`pageType` alias), both a different divergence.
